verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript 3D rendering library for WebGL and WebGPU. Setting up autonomous background automations is a workflow or agent-platform capability outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships scheduling or background-automation features; even its llms.txt files and the absence of an MCP server are documentation and agent-access topics, not automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
